name: Electra Metropolis
description: Electra Metropolis is located in the very heart of the city of Athens, next to Syntagma Square, on the foot of Acropolis Hill. Restaurants, bars and shops can be found just steps from the hotel, while the scenic Plaka area can be reached within a 10 minute walk. The nearest Metro station is just 5 minutes walk. The Eleftherios Venizelos Airport is 34 km from the hotel. The elegant rooms and suites at Electra Metropolis feature modern decor, wooden floors and warm tones. Each includes a marble-tiled bathroom with hairdryer, bathrobes, slippers and organic toiletries. A work desk, smart TV with satellite channels, a laptop safe and a minibar. Wi-Fi access is provided trhoughout. A retro-style lounge area, where guests can enjoy a coffee or drink, is featured at the unique sky-light atrium decorated with Fassianos artwork. Guests can also taste the Mediterranean flavours at the ground floor bistro featuring an open kitchen. The Electra Metropolis boasts a rooftop pool with waterfall effect and a sun terrace with views over the city. Gourmet dishes and refreshing cocktails can be enjoyed at the top-floor restaurant or at the M bar offering Panoramic views over the city.
